lenses.name: Temperature
lenses.description: Mean annual temperature, 1991–2020 climate normal from the Météo-France SIM2 reanalysis.

lenses.name: Warming
lenses.description: Difference between mean annual temperature in 1996–2025 and 1961–1990.

lenses.name: Rainfall
lenses.description: Mean annual precipitation, 1991–2020 climate normal from the SIM2 reanalysis.

lenses.name: Rainfall change
lenses.description: Change in mean annual precipitation between 1996–2025 and 1961–1990.

lenses.name: Climatic water deficit
lenses.description: Mean annual potential evapotranspiration minus total precipitation, 1991–2020. Positive values indicate a climatic moisture deficit before soil storage, irrigation, runoff and groundwater are considered.
